reason: The first outcome-blind certification treated the casebook aggregate component-completeness flag as if it meant a still-forming candle. That excluded closed H1/H4/D1 periods containing normal no-tick minutes and contradicted the frozen full-history and M1-aggregation traceability rules.

single_change.old_rule: Use only casebook H1/H4/D1 aggregates with complete=true.
single_change.new_rule: Use every closed casebook H1/H4/D1 aggregate derived from the sealed M1 source when available_at is not later than close_time. The complete flag is retained as a source-quality diagnostic; false means the closed interval contains fewer than every possible wall-clock M1 component, not that the candle was available before its close.
single_change.weekly_rule: Aggregate the amended closed daily sequence by ISO close week exactly as already frozen; require at least four observed closed daily periods.
single_change.decision_rule_unchanged: Only bars with close_time at or before the decision timestamp may enter a state or level.
